unverified.detail: This account's only registered withdrawal key (WithdrawAddresses) is labeled "Deribit" with a different address than the one client.toml's [policy.permissions].withdraw_addresses pre-approves (0xE089aB95D28aCA5804a2F99c2cc259A88d3Be799). Kraken requires a destination to already be a registered withdrawal key before Withdraw will accept it -- registering a new key is a manual, typically 2FA/email-confirmed action outside API scope. No in-policy address is callable right now.

spec.description: Cancel a recently requested withdrawal, if it has not already been successfully processed. Requires the `Funds permissions - Withdraw` API key permission, unless the withdrawal is a `WalletTransfer`, in which case no permissions are required.

response.title: WithdrawCancelFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

notes: Upstream `requestBody` requires `nonce`; dropped from this schema since the core's `authed_request` (`core/transport/http.py`) injects a strictly-increasing nonce into every private call automatically -- it is never a caller-supplied parameter, matching the existing hand-written `deposit_methods(self, asset)` signature, which takes none.
